name: read_file
description: Read one text file. Example: {"path":"src/app.ts","offset":120,"limit":80}. Relative paths use the session cwd. offset is the 1-based first line (default 1) and limit the number of lines (default 2000). The result shows each line after its number and a gutter (  120│text), then a footer such as [lines 120–199 of 431; next: offset 200] or [lines 1–40 of 40; end of file]. When the output budget ends the window early, the footer names the offset to read next. To read several files, make several calls.

path.description: File path, absolute or relative to the session cwd.

limit.description: Number of lines to read; default 2000.
